segments.arabic:
١١٥١٢- عمرة بنت مسعود بن قيس
بن عمرو بن زيد مناة بن عديّ «١» بن عمرو بن مالك بن النّجّار، والدة سعد بن عبادة.
ماتت في حياة النّبيّ ﵌ سنة خمس. قال ابن سعد: ماتت والنبيّ ﵌ في غزوة دومة الجندل في شهر ربيع الأول، فلما جاء النبيّ ﵌ المدينة أتى قبرها فصلّى عليها.
قلت: وثبت أنها لما ماتت سأل ولدها النّبيّ ﵌ عن الصّدقة عنها.
segments.english:
11512—Amra bint Mas'ud ibn Qays
ibn Amr ibn Zayd Manat ibn Adi (1) ibn Amr ibn Malik ibn al-Najjar, the mother of Sa'd ibn Ubada.

She died during the lifetime of the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, in the year 5. Ibn Sa'd said: She died while the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, was on the expedition to Dumat al-Jandal, in the month of Rabi al-Awwal. When the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, returned to Medina, he went to her grave and performed the funeral prayer over her.

I say: It is reliably established that, when she died, her son asked the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, about giving charity on her behalf.
